# Capture support table

<!-- Generated by scripts/support-table.py from docs/adapters/compatibility.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

This is the single place that says which client versions are supported and what is captured or held. README, the [setup guide](setup.md) and the [completion matrix](../architecture/completion-matrix.md) link here.

**A version not listed is not supported.** Where a client is version-pinned, other versions are refused with a message that points here; where it is not, only the tested version is evidence and the weekly release check flags newer releases. Held sessions never become complete because a later message looks clean. Codex and Antigravity stay experimental; Windows is unsupported; everything else uses the universal fallback (explicit export and the assistant-written flow).

| Client | Tested version | OS | Status | What is captured | What is held or limited | Other versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cursor | 3.23.23 | macOS | Opt-in, certification pending | Prompts and responses of explicitly callback-bound Agents-window sessions on This Mac, recovered privately for 24 hours | Unsupported context holds the session; sessions missed before enrollment are not detected; owner review before anything is shared | Refused: private recovery stays off (`cursor_version_unverified`) |
| Claude Code | 2.1.293 | macOS (tested) | Partial | Visible prompt and response hook fields; coverage is partial | Anything the hook fields do not carry; the optional edit-protection hook is separate and needs 2.1.295 or later | Not checked at capture time; only the tested version is evidence. A newer release may half-work, so the release check flags it |
| Gemini CLI | n/a | not tested | Partial | Hook fields only; no live certification | Broad live certification pending | Not tested |
| Codex | 0.162.0-alpha.2 | macOS | Experimental | Visible no-tool turns, delivered through enrolled hooks | Tool use, subagents, compaction and ambiguous context hold the session | Refused at enrollment; Codex 0.162.0-alpha.17.2 was rejected |
| Antigravity | 2.19.1 | macOS | Experimental, publication held | Hook delivery and private capture of the exact callback-bound transcript | All native turns remain held and cannot be published (terminal attribution unverified) | Not supported |
| Claude Desktop | n/a | macOS (isolated broker) | Partial | Explicit consent-bound text pull | Needs Enterprise read entitlement; live deployment acceptance pending | n/a |
| Workspace Knowledge managed chat | n/a | any | Implemented, unverified | Explicitly selected, visible prompt and response | Unverified against live providers | n/a |
| Past-session import (Claude Code, Codex, VS Code Copilot Chat, Cursor) | n/a | macOS | Partial | Sessions you list, review and choose with `wk agent-history` and `wk-agent import`; read-only, never automatic | Coverage is partial; storage formats are undocumented and version-dependent | Not checked; a format change can make a session unreadable |
| VS Code GitHub Copilot (MCP) | n/a | any | Partial | Nothing: agent mode can call the knowledge tools through `.vscode/mcp.json` | No capture hooks and no automatic prompt-time notices yet | n/a |
| Windows (any client) | n/a | Windows | Unsupported | Nothing: native capture is not supported | Use explicit export or the assistant-written flow | n/a |
| Any other client or version | n/a | any | Fallback | Explicit export (`wk-agent import`, `/wk-summarize`) of sessions you choose | Nothing is captured automatically; every card is private until reviewed | n/a |

Evidence and limits: [native acceptance](../reviews/2026-10-09-native-capture-acceptance.md), [native follow-up](../reviews/2026-10-10-native-capture-follow-up.md). Machine-readable source: [`compatibility.json`](compatibility.json).
